keyPoints.en: Minerals are natural elements (gold, silver) or compounds (oxides, sulfides, carbonates).
keyPoints.bm: Mineral ialah unsur semula jadi (emas, argentum) atau sebatian (oksida, sulfida, karbonat).

keyPoints.en: Examples: bauxite (Al oxide), haematite (Fe oxide), cassiterite (Sn oxide), galena (Pb sulfide), limestone (Ca carbonate).
keyPoints.bm: Contoh: bauksit (Al oksida), hematit (Fe oksida), kasiterit (Sn oksida), galena (Pb sulfida), batu kapur (Ca karbonat).

keyPoints.en: Series: K > Na > Ca > Mg > Al > (C) > Zn > Fe > Sn > Pb > Cu > Hg > Ag > Au.
keyPoints.bm: Siri: K > Na > Ca > Mg > Al > (C) > Zn > Fe > Sn > Pb > Cu > Hg > Ag > Au.

keyPoints.en: Judge reactivity by how brightly/vigorously a metal burns in oxygen (lab source: heated potassium manganate(VII)).
keyPoints.bm: Nilai kereaktifan berdasarkan kecerahan/kecergasan logam terbakar dalam oksigen (sumber makmal: kalium manganat(VII) yang dipanaskan).

tip.en: Mnemonic idea: make your own sentence from K-Na-Ca-Mg-Al-C-Zn-Fe-Sn-Pb-Cu-Hg-Ag-Au.
tip.bm: Cadangan: cipta ayat sendiri daripada K-Na-Ca-Mg-Al-C-Zn-Fe-Sn-Pb-Cu-Hg-Ag-Au.

keyPoints.en: Metals below carbon: heat the oxide with carbon (reduction) — e.g. iron, tin.
keyPoints.bm: Logam di bawah karbon: panaskan oksida bersama karbon (penurunan) — cth. besi, timah.

keyPoints.en: Blast furnace: haematite + coke + limestone + hot air; limestone removes impurities as slag.
keyPoints.bm: Relau bagas: hematit + kok + batu kapur + udara panas; batu kapur menyingkirkan bendasing sebagai sanga.

keyPoints.en: Metals above carbon (e.g. aluminium): electrolysis — energy-intensive, so recycling matters.
keyPoints.bm: Logam di atas karbon (cth. aluminium): elektrolisis — memerlukan banyak tenaga, jadi kitar semula penting.
